description: Blocks until a new message arrives at the address, then returns it in full — the tool to use after submitting a sign-up form. Waits at most 25 seconds and then returns with timed_out set to true; call it again to keep waiting. Optionally waits for a message from a particular sender or with particular words in the subject, ignoring anything else that arrives.

from_contains.description: Only accept a message whose sender contains this.

since_id.description: Ignore this message and anything older; pass the newest id you have already seen.

subject_contains.description: Only accept a message whose subject contains this.

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for a message to arrive
